families.recipe_and_oracle: Boot current Mosaic with each supported mod profile; select by verified displayed name, author a note, observe its intended output and no other route
families.edges_and_negatives: Cold/warm load, mod absent/disabled, changed engine/Crow Lua identity, failed engine readiness; no fallback to MIDI or silent success

families.recipe_and_oracle: Capture while grid/key/MIDI actions run; export and independently verify samples, sequence, hashes and terminal job status
families.edges_and_negatives: Short/long bounds, cancel, backend death, truncation, missing file, nonfinite samples and overflow must fail; emulator contracts reused, one composed Mosaic fault guard

families.recipe_and_oracle: Run two isolated sessions with distinct pitches/ports; stop one and continue the other
families.edges_and_negatives: No OSC/audio/CV/ii crossover, held input or capture leakage; three fresh restarts; run serially except this bounded isolation case

families.recipe_and_oracle: Author full phrases on channels1/16; assign MIDI, DoubleDecker and each supported JF voice mode via controls
families.edges_and_negatives: Confirm/cancel; assigned unique n.b. player excluded from other channels, freed player becomes selectable again; distinct compatible JF voices/mixed players; route switch stopped/playing; old releases retain ownership

families.recipe_and_oracle: Play distinct pitches and velocities through each supported player
families.edges_and_negatives: Pitch low/middle/high legal values, octave boundaries; velocity minimum, midpoint, maximum, zero only where UI supports it; no hard-coded shared gain formula

families.recipe_and_oracle: Retrigger same pitch with shorter/equal/longer durations; overlapping chords and repeated notes on two channels
families.edges_and_negatives: Old release must not cut a newly owned voice; missing release, wrong voice and duplicate onset fault fixtures fail

families.recipe_and_oracle: Stop/restart during held notes, strums and arps; mute/unmute and route changes
families.edges_and_negatives: Final owned releases, bounded declared effect tail, no ghost restart notes; test MIDI panic separately—manual promises a MIDI sweep, not universal nb.stop_all

families.recipe_and_oracle: Exercise supported mono/poly/kit/MPE/unison JF selections
families.edges_and_negatives: Independently specified setup, voice allocation, pitch/level packets and final releases; all finite voices, repeated/overlapping notes, allocation exhaustion/stealing, mode switch with pending notes/slew, parameter limits; unsupported functions explicit

families.recipe_and_oracle: Reuse independent scale/transposition/octave/chord recipes on audio and JF
families.edges_and_negatives: Signed pitch boundaries, root mute, duplicate pitches, strum/arp order and rests; full phrase, no missing voice hidden by aggregate spectrum

families.recipe_and_oracle: Apply player parameter defaults, locks, trigless locks and slides through controls
families.edges_and_negatives: Off/zero/bounds; lock→unlocked-trig restoration including original zero, manual edit during lock, device/parameter reassignment with queued slide; non-1 range/wrap/descending chains/song change/stop; no stale target writes or NRPN waiver

families.recipe_and_oracle: Configure each supported matrix/toolkit path to a player parameter, then manual edit and lock it
families.edges_and_negatives: Depth/rate boundaries, enable/disable, channel switch, competing lock/mod/manual precedence; sound/voltage/wire trajectory and displayed parameter must agree

families.recipe_and_oracle: Change tempo/division/swing while notes or parameter motion remain pending
families.edges_and_negatives: Duration/phase continuity and ordered releases; no D-only acceptance and no broadened timing tolerance to excuse musical error

families.recipe_and_oracle: Record keyboard notes/chords assigned to audio/JF; replay and inspect grid, duration and output route
families.edges_and_negatives: Disarmed live audition; held key across selected-channel/device changes; live/sequenced same-pitch overlap with exact release ownership; before/on/after boundary, unequal rates, first-press/final-release, arm/disarm

families.recipe_and_oracle: Save/autosave, fresh-process reload and replay mixed-output song
families.edges_and_negatives: Mod/player identity, per-channel selection, parameters, locks/slides, song slots and routes preserved; dirty source identity bound per run

families.recipe_and_oracle: Load with missing/disabled player or incompatible capability; cancel then recover with correct profile
families.edges_and_negatives: Explicit diagnostic, prior project preserved, no silently substituted voice; failed/truncated save and unknown player ID

families.recipe_and_oracle: Select the supported CV player; author pitch/gate/velocity or slew gestures actually exposed by that player
families.edges_and_negatives: All supported output mappings, min/max/signed voltages, rests, legato/retrigger, stop/restart; no crosstalk or stale gate; preserve output units

families.recipe_and_oracle: Feed Crow clock pulses via public input and run Mosaic phrase; switch internal→Crow→internal
families.edges_and_negatives: Missing/extra pulses, tempo change, stopped/started source, source handoff with held note; prove clock lock/origin before measuring onset and release; no fabricated sample-level timing

families.recipe_and_oracle: Feed supported voltage change/stream inputs to an actual documented Mosaic/player consumer
families.edges_and_negatives: Threshold equality/hysteresis, repeated identical voltage, both inputs, callback burst and stream stop; if no consumer exists, retain generic conformance ownership and explicit not-applicable rationale

families.recipe_and_oracle: Capture JF setup/note/release across pages, simultaneous voices and lifecycle
families.edges_and_negatives: Exact commands/order/addresses, page boundary256 records, tail drain, no unrelated packets; dropped/reordered/repeated/partial record negative guards

families.recipe_and_oracle: Ten-minute mixed MIDI/audio/JF/CV workload with editing, autosave, chords and clock changes
families.edges_and_negatives: Complete MIDI/ii trace integrity plus bounded PCM/CV windows around transitions/final release; no stuck voices/gates in observed windows or growing clocks/process leaks; preserve MIDI limits and predeclare audio/Crow measurement limits

families.recipe_and_oracle: Automate browser controls over Mosaic during audio monitoring; compare actual framebuffer/grid and rendered PCM
families.edges_and_negatives: Focus loss while held, monitor enable/disable, disconnect/reconnect, capture concurrent with monitoring; mute monitor must not stop sequencer or capture

families.recipe_and_oracle: Ten reload/stop/reset cycles including one failed engine/Crow session
families.edges_and_negatives: Owned cleanup, retained failure evidence, no orphan service or other-session interruption; unexpected exit fails and captures native stack on recurrence
